title: In a DM between two people with the agent added: the peer asks, the owner confirms, the agent acts for both

turns.prompt: Hi — I'm the owner. My colleague is in this chat too. Please take the meeting notes we post here and keep a running summary in {D}/dm-notes.md.
[peer] @lane-a note from me: we agreed the launch date is 12 November and Priya owns the checklist. Please add it to the summary.
turns.verify: f={D}/dm-notes.md; test -f $f && grep -q 'November' $f && grep -qi priya $f && echo PASS || echo FAIL: peer note not in the summary

turns.prompt: Read the summary back to us, and say who posted the launch-date note.

rubric.criteria: The agent attributes the launch-date note to the colleague / second person (by handle or display name such as 'Long-task eval peer' — NOT to the owner who is asking) and reads the summary back accurately. Attributing it to the owner scores 0; naming the peer by any of their identifiers is a full pass.

regression: D72 people chats with an agent member: two humans, one agent; #2069 was a harness artefact (arbosctl replay); re-graded PASS on 0.1.163; run 16: t3 did not finish before the task timeout; passed when re-run alone, so not reproducible
